chunks: He says: 'Are you one of those who can testify to the truth?'

key_terms.أَ: Interrogative particle indicating a question or surprise
key_terms.الْمُصَدِّقِينَ: Those who testify to the truth / affirmers

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Are you one of those who testify to the truth?' mean in Surah As-Saffat?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse captures the moment of regret where disbelievers, recognizing the truth of the believers' steadfastness, attempt to join them but are rejected. It underscores the concept of *Tawatur* (widespread confirmation) and the finality of divine decree, illustrating that mere acknowledgment of truth without prior conviction is insufficient for salvation. The dialogue serves as a poignant reminder of the separation between the *Muhaqqiqun* (those who verified faith) and the *Munqarin* (the doubters) on the Day of Resurrection.
